title: amma fiza bata do mujhko
body:
Amma fizza.. Amma fizza..(2)
Amma fizza.. Amma fizza..(2)
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..(2)
Kaisa hai yeh charagha, dil doobe jaa rahe hai
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Haye, itna chale hai paidal, kaan'to pe saare qaidi
thak jaati chalte chalte, chalti agar zamee'n bhi
payro ke aable bhi, aasu baha rahe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Hai log kis tarha ke, hum se dua karaye
aye qaidiyo'n dua do, yeh din na hum pe aaye
haye, lekar duaei'n hum se, dil bhi dukha rahe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..

3. Haaye..
Naizo pe jitne sar hai, ek sar hai unmein aisa
aakhein hai band uski, aur khaak par hai girta
abbas ka yeh sar hai, tewar bata rahe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..

4. Maao'n ki godiyo'n se, lipte hue hai bacche
hai haath rassiyo mein, maao'n ke aise jakde
bacche jo gir rahe hai, woh marte jaa rhe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haaye..
Naize pe ro raha hai, mushkil kusha ka beta
na mehramo ke lab par, aaya hai naam mera
mujhko kaneez zaade, yu'n bhi rula rahe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..

6. Sajjad ka kaleja, sad paash ho raha hai
ek ek zakhm unka, is ghum me ro raha hai
zainab ka naam lekar, aada rula rahe hai
<<MINI>>
kya shaam aagaya hai?
Amma fizza bata de mujhko, patthar kyu aa rhe hai..

7. Rehan qaidiyo'n mein, barpa hai shor e girya
palko se kar rahi hai, matam wo bint e zahra
sajjad nauha khwa'n hai, nauha suna rahe hai

kya shaam aagaya hai?
